reference_prolog:
% Facts derived from the Administrative Appeals Office case, encoded as 0-arity predicates
filed_i360.
has_two_prior_marriages.
submitted_initial_divorce_nisi_and_absolute.
submitted_customary_court_divorce_decree.

director_questioned_customary_status_and_jurisdiction.
director_reported_adverse_intel_about_initial_signer.
director_denied_for_lack_of_qualifying_relationship.
director_dismissed_motion_to_reopen_and_reconsider.

submitted_corrected_decrees_signed_by_different_assistant_chief_registrar.
director_acknowledged_signature_appears_authentic_but_stamp_mismatch.
director_found_evidence_insufficient_after_corrections.

on_appeal_submitted_brief_and_additional_evidence.
explained_sequence_customary_then_high_court_decrees.
nigerian_law_firm_confirmed_high_court_confirmation.
nigerian_embassy_confirmation_obtained.
submitted_amended_decree_nisi_and_certificate_of_decree_absolute_2023_with_nigerian_embassy_seal.
submitted_nigerian_attorney_affidavit_and_federal_ministry_of_foreign_affairs_certification.

petitioner_asserts_documents_authentic_and_inadequate_notice_of_adverse_intel.
petitioner_alleged_abuse_by_us_citizen_spouse.

% Eligibility elements for VAWA self-petition (encoded as facts when supported by the record)
married_to_us_citizen.               % petitioner sought classification as abused spouse of a U.S. citizen
married_in_good_faith.               % petitioner asserted the marriage to the U.S. citizen was in good faith
resided_with_spouse.                 % petitioner alleged cohabitation with U.S. citizen spouse
subjected_to_battery_or_extreme_cruelty. % petitioner sought VAWA relief alleging abuse
good_moral_character.                % no adverse facts in the record contesting moral character

% Evidence bearing on termination of prior marriages (primary issue in this case)
% The director initially found the record did not establish legal termination of the prior marriage.
initial_record_did_not_establish_termination :- director_reported_adverse_intel_about_initial_signer;
                                              director_questioned_customary_status_and_jurisdiction;
                                              director_found_evidence_insufficient_after_corrections.

% Subsequent documentary certifications submitted on appeal
embassy_seal_certified_decrees :- submitted_amended_decree_nisi_and_certificate_of_decree_absolute_2023_with_nigerian_embassy_seal.
ministry_certified_decrees :- submitted_nigerian_attorney_affidavit_and_federal_ministry_of_foreign_affairs_certification.
law_firm_confirmation :- nigerian_law_firm_confirmed_high_court_confirmation.

% Credibility rule: USCIS may weigh evidence, but official authentication by the issuing country's consular or foreign affairs authorities is strong evidence of authenticity.
% We model that embassy seal + ministry certification + corrected decrees together constitute credible proof of legal termination of prior marriage.
prior_marriage_terminated :-
    embassy_seal_certified_decrees,
    ministry_certified_decrees,
    submitted_corrected_decrees_signed_by_different_assistant_chief_registrar.

% If termination is not proven, then the petitioner lacks a qualifying relationship.
lacks_qualifying_relationship :-
    \+ prior_marriage_terminated.

% Eligibility requires all statutory elements and proof of termination of prior marriages (if any)
eligibility_met :-
    married_to_us_citizen,
    married_in_good_faith,
    resided_with_spouse,
    subjected_to_battery_or_extreme_cruelty,
    good_moral_character,
    \+ lacks_qualifying_relationship.

% Entrypoint and decision output (must be last)
decision(Result) :-
    (   eligibility_met
    ->  Result = 'Accepted'
    ;   Result = 'Dismissed'
    ).

run :-
    catch(
        (   decision(Result),
            writeln(Result)
        ),
        error(existence_error(procedure, PI), _),
        handle_undefined(PI)
    ).

handle_undefined(Name/Arity) :-
    (   current_predicate(Name/OtherArity),
        OtherArity \= Arity
    ->  format('Programming error: called ~w/~w, but only ~w/~w is defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity, Name, OtherArity])
    ;   format('Lack of information: predicate ~w/~w is not defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity])
    ).
